description: Defines a template class 'executor_metrics_decorator' that decorates a task executor to track performance metrics such as latency, resource usage, and execution counts. It manages a pool of tasks, handles execution and deferral, and reports metrics via a channel, with optional tracing.

classes.name: executor_metrics_decorator
classes.description: A template class that wraps a task executor to measure and report performance metrics, including latency and resource usage, with task pooling and optional tracing.

methods.name: executor_metrics_decorator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with executor, metrics channel, tracer, and task pool.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides task execution to measure enqueue time, obtain a pooled task, and run the task with metrics tracking.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Overrides task deferral to measure enqueue time, obtain a pooled task, and defer execution with metrics tracking.

methods.name: run_task
methods.description: Runs the task, measures start and end times, resource usage, and calls handle_metrics to report metrics.

methods.name: handle_metrics
methods.description: Calculates latency and resource usage differences, optionally traces, and updates the metrics channel.
